::: hero
# PHYVIR

Resolving marine phytoplankton–virus interactions from local to global scales.
:::

Phytoplankton, the microscopic plants of the ocean, produce roughly half of the
oxygen on Earth, take up large amounts of CO~2~, and feed marine food webs.
They are also infected by viruses. How much those infections shape ocean
productivity and carbon and nutrient cycling is still poorly known.
PHYVIR combines laboratory experiments, an Atlantic Ocean expedition and global
ecosystem models to close that gap.
